name: DMD 5081
title: Digital Media Graduate Internship
description: Supervised internship work that supports a student’s graduate training and career goals. Allows students to participate in an internship while also taking courses. Evaluation is completed by the Digital Media and Design Internship Coordinator. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required; students must secure a satisfactory internship position before the end of the second week of the semester in which they are enrolled in this course.
